name: Ablutions & washhouses
text: From a single bathroom inside a shelter to full facilities with toilets, sinks and showers — with reverse-osmosis water systems and storage bladders.

name: Kitchens
text: Tactical kitchens up to full-service kitchens feeding 1,000 people three fresh meals a day. The MSVS kitchen built for Canada’s DND feeds 500 at once.

name: Laundry
text: Batch or self-serve laundry for 250–500 people, operational in under an hour once connected to power, water and effluent catchment.

name: Sleeping quarters
text: Climate-controlled accommodation in Series 4, Series 8, MTS or HERCon shelters — single rooms to dormitory bunks, fully furnished.

name: Floors
text: Tactical floors for frequent moves, economical floors for long deployments, anti-static tile for medical and checker-plate for workshops.

name: Electrical, mechanical & water
text: Pre-assembled, code-certified electrical kits, heating and ventilation, water purification, sewage treatment and medical-waste incineration.

name: Mobilizers & trailers
text: The LH55 mobilizer moves 10' or 20' ISO containers over rough terrain — or on the highway at up to 55 mph (89 km/h) once converted.

name: Security
text: Redeployable perimeter and electric fencing, lighting towers and defensive barriers, sourced through Weatherhaven’s supply network.
